title: Back-to-back on tired legs, rolling, D+ capped 400m
terrain: valley / rolling forest, D+ and D- both under 400m

steps.target: Z2 rolling, 80-88% LTHR, run every climb

coachNotes: This stays at 80 and it stays rolling. The back-to-back is the point, the vertical is not. You will have 1000m of descent in the legs from Saturday, on top of 1206m on Wednesday, and Wednesday's was the first descent in 17 days: three descent days inside five is already the aggressive read of the ITB history, a fourth big one is the version that ends the build. D+ AND D- BOTH CAPPED AT 400m, non-technical, and if the forecast holds it will be raining anyway, meteoblue gives 10-20mm and the models scatter from 4 to 20. The arithmetic on going big both days: Sat 155 plus Sun 155 lands CTL at 45.0 against 43.4 for the plan as written, so the entire prize is 1.6 CTL points, on a target of 42 that you are already past, 20 days out, in exchange for 2000m of descent in 48 hours. That is not a trade, and TSB would sit at -30 into a travel week. LAST DAY IN THE ALPS, which is exactly the psychology that makes people go big, so it is being named in advance. If it rains hard: 60-75min flat easy, or full rest, both are fine and neither costs anything. Eat every 40 minutes regardless, the fuelling rehearsal is cheap and you get few chances left. Garmin expect 130-160.
